# 重置从节点为单节点
> [!TIP]
> 重置过程与

## 原从节点信息

### 节点信息

> 命令：kubectl describe node \<node-name\> | grep -E "Container Runtime|Kubelet Version|Kube-Proxy Version|PodCIDR|PodCIDRs|Taints|Labels"

```
Labels:             N=one
Taints:             <none>
 Container Runtime Version:  docker://27.5.1
 Kubelet Version:            v1.23.17
 Kube-Proxy Version:         v1.23.17
```

> 命令：kubectl -n kube-system get cm kubeadm-config -o yaml | grep -E ‘podSubnet|serviceSubnet|dnsDomain|kubernetesVersion’

```
serviceSubnet: 10.96.0.0/12
```

  
 

### kube-proxy

> kubectl -n kube-system get cm kube-proxy -o yaml

```
apiVersion: v1
data:
  # ......
  mode: ""
  # ......
```

mode 为空，表示使用 `iptables`模式

### 网络插件信息

> 命令:  kubectl get ds -n kube-system

```
NAME             DESIRED   CURRENT   READY   UP-TO-DATE   AVAILABLE   NODE SELECTOR            AGE
calico-node      2         2         2       2            2           kubernetes.io/os=linux   708d
kube-multus-ds   2         2         0       2            0           <none>                   136d
kube-proxy       2         2         2       2            2           kubernetes.io/os=linux   708d

```

 使用的是 calico CNI，镜像：docker.io/calico/cni:master

docker.io/calico/cni:v3.25.0

### Docker cgroupDriver

> sudo docker info | grep -i "Cgroup Driver"

Cgroup Driver: systemd

### k8s 镜像仓库

> kubectl -n kube-system get cm kubeadm-config -o yaml | grep -A 50 ‘imageRepository’

```
imageRepository: registry.aliyuncs.com/google_containers
```

## 重置步骤

### 将从节点从旧集群中移除

> kubectl drain \<node-name\> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data 
> 
> kubectl delete node \<node-name\>

### 在原从节点上重置 kubeadm

> sudo kubeadm reset -f

然后清理旧 CNI 和 kubelet 残留：

> sudo systemctl stop kubelet
> 
> sudo rm -rf /etc/cni/net.d  
> sudo rm -rf /var/lib/cni  
> sudo rm -rf /var/lib/kubelet/\*  
> sudo rm -rf /etc/kubernetes

### 准备 kubeadm 初始化配置 

创建配置文件，并加入以下内容：

```
apiVersion: kubeadm.k8s.io/v1beta3
kind: InitConfiguration
localAPIEndpoint:
  advertiseAddress: 192.168.121.12
  bindPort: 6443
nodeRegistration:
  name: k8s-node-1
    #criSocket: unix:///var/run/dockershim.sock
  kubeletExtraArgs:
    node-ip: 192.168.121.12
---
apiVersion: kubeadm.k8s.io/v1beta3
kind: ClusterConfiguration
kubernetesVersion: v1.23.17
imageRepository: registry.aliyuncs.com/google_containers
networking:
  dnsDomain: cluster.local
  podSubnet: 10.244.0.0/16
  serviceSubnet: 10.96.0.0/16
---
apiVersion: kubelet.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: KubeletConfiguration
cgroupDriver: systemd
```
